Background

Ryeoun is a rising South Korean actor known for his versatile acting skills and charming screen presence. He quickly established himself as a prominent young talent in the Korean entertainment industry through a variety of leading and supporting roles.

Why I Love Them

I first really became attached to Ryeoun because of his characters, especially Ha Eun-gyeol in Twinkling Watermelon and Park Hu-min in Weak Hero Class 2. There is something about the way he plays warm, caring, and emotionally strong characters that makes them easy to love. I love how he can make a character funny and adorable one moment, then suddenly make me emotional in another scene. He has this natural charm that makes me want to keep watching whatever character he plays next. And honestly... he's also just so damn handsome. 😭 I like every role he portrayed. His smile melts my heart.

✨ Iconic Roles & Career Highlights

🎬
Twinkling Watermelon (2023)
Ha Eun-gyeol
A talented CODA student and guitarist who travels back in time and becomes involved in his parents' youth. One of my favorite Ryeoun performances and probably the role that made me love him the most.
🎬
Weak Hero Class 2 (2025)
Park Hu-min / Baku
The cheerful and physically strong leader of the Eunjang High students. Despite his intimidating strength, he genuinely cares about his friends and stands up for people who need help.

Cat Butler 🐈
